_SAMPLE_DATA: INVENTED, INCLUDING THE ORGANISATION NAMES. Every club below is fictional and every meeting time, office hour, person and room assignment was made up to demonstrate the feature. The buildings are real; nothing else on this list is. Do not go anywhere on its word.
_whyFictionalNames: An earlier draft used the real RIT chapters (NSBE, SHPE, SWE, RITSEC and others) with invented schedules. On a public URL that is a trap: a student could find a plausible-looking time for their actual club and turn up to an empty room. The names were replaced with obvious placeholders so no invented schedule can be mistaken for a real one. data/campus_life.realnames.json keeps the real-chapter version for local demos and is excluded from deployment.
_howToReplace: Each entry's `at` must be a node key from CAMPUS_GRAPH.nodes in campus.json, or routing to it will fail. Run tools/check_campus_life.py after editing. When real schedules are confirmed, replace the names and delete _SAMPLE_DATA.
